g.text: app — 应用编排层 (App, Service, 事件, 定时器)
debug — 调试工具 (Inspect HTTP/WS 服务器, Tracer)
fsm — 状态机与行为树 (FSM, BehaviorTree, BtFactory)
net — 网络 (TCP/UDP, HTTP Client/Server, WebSocket, TLS)
tasks — 异步任务 (TaskRunner, TaskGroup, Timer, CronScheduler, Event)
system — 系统抽象 (eventfd, PagedMemory, SignalHandler, UnixSocket)
utils — 通用工具 (JSON, String, File, Base64, SHA1, WeakPtr, Scoped)
